title: Time-dependent multiparameter estimation for quantum experiments via online-offline sequential Monte-Carlo method
summary: While typical online estimation methods can estimate the multiparameter dynamics of many systems, they may not be sufficient for a system with highly noisy measurement and rapid detection rate. In this paper, we create a hybrid estimation method by augmenting the sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) sampler, an online estimation method with an offline technique known as the time-batch estimation technique.
